reason: It survives only as conditional logistics. It is not new: it duplicates R24S-3 (W4 rows a/b), R24S-4 (build exp87a-j) and R24S-6 (T2 push) from the same scan. It is legitimate, though, because CONTEXT 27 Sep 16:08Z (5) pre-registered it: 'attributable UP -> one 29 Sep stack best division file + coordinject (ALPHA 0.5, MAX_UM 3.0)'. So it is not post-hoc and not a closed line (CI is not float output). The build costs only CPU and is byte-identical to its parents apart from the knob lines and the CI cell. The CI stage fails soft: the COORDINJECT deadline of 37,800 s keeps the K2 rows. Four weaknesses cut its value. (1) Private value is about 0. The finals card (04:31Z (1)) makes every CI file info-only or public-only, because the CI lab is in-sample on 4 clips (+0.0032 pooled, but -0.021 / +0.0125 / 0 / +0.0083 per clip). The stack cannot become V_pub without a user re-tick, so its gain is public display, not prize EV. (2) The claimed +0.001 to +0.002 is optimistic. exp70g is 10th of 59 in the 0.956 block. If 48 and 50 each read 0.957, each could be a small rounding crossing, and the stack would most likely still display 0.957, so additivity is usually unobservable. The 'non-additive -> stop' rule is vacuous in W4: the read lands around 29 Sep 08-10Z, and no later slot is left to stop. (3) The push timing is wrong. The stack is used only under R+, but 50 (READMIT) lands around 12:27-12:50Z, after T2 (48 at around 09:40-10:40Z). Pushing at T2, or 'now' as scan_hyp_portedpp says, can burn about 30 GPU-min of the roughly 7 GPU-h left on a branch that dies under R0/R-. The dummy deadline of 23:30Z leaves more than 10 h after both reads. (4) The gate reference for exp87b/c does not exist yet. The exp86a/exp86b (JT(b)) dummies were pushed at 06:36Z and have no gated CSV. At 07:02Z, 47/48/49/50 were all PENDING and exp87* was not built.
fix: Build exp87a/b/c now (CPU only) exactly as R24S-4 specifies. Diff-check each against both parents: only the cell-0 knob lines plus the coordinject cell may differ. Ledger rule: exp87[abce] -> safetail_ci. Add the R8 COVERAGE line. Push a dummy only at T3, i.e. after BOTH 48 and 50 are terminal. Condition 1: 48 is C+ with CI-RAN (dL >= 1.2 h, L_hi <= 10.2 h), or a testable C? (MASKED / BLIND / 0.5 < dL < 1.2 h). Condition 2: 50 is R+. Push only the realized-BASE member (exp87a for exp70g; exp87b/c only if 49 / 47 made that BASE), solo lane or with a logged concurrent lane. Gate (write it before reading): R22-A1 with the JT(b) dummy CSV as the topology reference. That means exp85a 122,328 / 118,137 / 85 for exp87a, and the gated exp86a/exp86b CSVs for exp87b/c, which must be downloaded and gated first. The changed-integer-coordinate fraction must be 0.60-0.69. Runtime must be <= 2,100 s solo or <= 2,500 s with a logged concurrent lane. Submit only in the W4 CI slot at 00:06Z (last chance 00:46Z), next to the non-CI twin JT(b). Pre-register three lines. (a) The stack is public-only and cannot be V_pub without a user re-tick. (b) Its read is a two-lever display on one embryo: info for the user, not an additivity test. (c) For exp87c, if exp78b reads L_hi > 8.2 h, expect a 'v' suffix (L_hi > 10.2 h after about 2 h of CI) and prefer exp87a/b.

Private / finals: about 0, since the CI file is info-only unless the user re-ticks. The actual finals value sits in the non-CI twin JT(b). Cost: CPU build now, 1 dummy (about 30 GPU-min) only in-branch, 1 W4 CI slot.
